messages:
sam: PSA — last call for changelog one-liners. Cutoff in ~6h (today 18:00 PT). If your PR needs a line, add it to the PR description or drop a short line into the changelog file. :alarm_clock:

release-bot: cutoff timer started — expires in 6 hours. Please follow the one-line shape: Component — short description. Automated lint will run on merge.

tanya: adding mine now. tiny question: do we still prefer the component prefix (e.g., "runtime") or the three canonical tags? I used 'runtime' in my PR heading.

mario: small Q: include PR number in the one-liner or keep it out? I usually put (#1234) but not sure if we want it in the changelog file.

sam: prefer to include PR# in the PR description only. Changelog one-liners should be compact — adding '(#1234)' inline is fine but not required. Our release tooling will link PRs automatically from metadata.

chris: reminder — please use the component taxonomy (serving / runtime / console / infra / docs). It helps the release notes generator group entries. If you're unsure, pick the closest one.

jen: quick lint tip — one-liners should be <120 chars, start with a capital letter, and avoid leading verbs like "Add" or "Fix" (prefer noun-first). The CI lint sometimes misses pre-merge, so manual checks help.

sam: example snippet to copy into PR description:

```
Component — short sentence concisely describing change. Optional: (PR#)
Example: Console — show model latency breakdown per-request (#4321)
```

tanya: adding this: "Runtime — reduce KV cache memory by ~15% (perf tests included) (#4321)". I'll put it in both the PR and the changelog.

mario: done — PR updated and label `needs-release-note` added. Can someone sanity-check mine? :eyes:

chris: looked — looks good. Maybe drop the parentheses around perf note: "Runtime — reduce KV cache memory by ~15%; adds perf tests". Shorter reads better in the release.

mario: updated per chris. thanks.

sam: thanks all. We'll do a sweep 30 minutes before cutoff and nudge any PRs missing entries. If you're blocked on wording, drop the draft here and I'll help tighten. :white_check_mark:
